scope: Equation-level candidate models for ultra-low-error quantum control; cosmology, dark matter, inflation, and deep-space sectors are excluded from this branch.
epistemic_rule: Software PASS does not imply new physics. Novelty requires outperforming matched conventional baselines and surviving prior-art review.

A.name: Deterministic Latent-Bath Cancellation
A.kill: FAIL_DISTINCT_METHOD if <=5% improvement over matched AR/Kalman-class baseline; FAIL_USEFUL if no improvement over no-control in high-structure regime

B.name: Lyapunov Attractor Logical Stabilization
B.kill: FAIL_STABILITY if local perturbations fail to contract; NOT_NOVEL if no separable prediction beyond reservoir/autonomous QEC

C.name: Predictive-Attractor Hybrid
C.kill: FAIL_SYNERGY if hybrid does not exceed the best component by 5%
